note: _nostis_ (= _novistis_, from _noscere) omnia_ – _ignorantibus veritatem_ – _scientibus eam:_ you know everything, to those who ignore truth, to those who know it. The translator on purpose uses three different Latin words for the Greek οἴδατε, thrice repeated.

_et hanc est repromissio_ (_quam ipse pollicitus est nobis_) _vitam aeternam_ – And this is the pomise which he hath promised us: life everlasting (Douay Version). In the Latin we have added the brackets for structural clarity. One would expect _vita aeterna_ (instead of _vitam aeternam_). This is a case of “inverse attraction” (Kaulen, p. 288, no. 180). The NVg keeps _vitam aeternam_.
